result.instructions: Tools for Aircall, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Aircall data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run aircall_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run aircall_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run aircall_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. aircall_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: aircall_ping
tools.title: Ping
tools.description: Health check — verify the API is reachable and the credentials are valid. Aircall REST: GET /ping.

tools.name: aircall_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get details of the authenticated Aircall company (name, plan, usage). Aircall REST: GET /company.

tools.name: aircall_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (agents) in the Aircall company (id, name, email, availability). Aircall REST: GET /users.

tools.name: aircall_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get a single user (agent) by id. Aircall REST: GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: List calls, optionally filtered by a creation-date window and ordered. Aircall REST: GET /calls.

from.description: Minimal creation date — a UNIX timestamp or ISO 8601 string.

to.description: Maximal creation date — a UNIX timestamp or ISO 8601 string.

order.description: Sort order by creation date — 'asc' or 'desc' (default asc).

fetch_contact.description: If true, include the full contact details of each call.

tools.name: aircall_get_call
tools.title: Get call
tools.description: Get a single call by id. Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}.

fetch_contact.description: If true, include the full contact details for the call.

tools.name: aircall_search_calls
tools.title: Search calls
tools.description: Search calls by a free-text term (e.g. phone number, tag, direction). Aircall REST: GET /calls/search.

q.description: Search term to match calls against.

tools.name: aircall_list_numbers
tools.title: List numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers owned by the company (id, name, digits, country). Aircall REST: GET /numbers.

tools.name: aircall_get_number
tools.title: Get number
tools.description: Get a single phone number by id. Aircall REST: GET /numbers/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the shared address book, optionally by creation-date window and order. Aircall REST: GET /contacts.

order.description: Sort order by creation date — 'asc' or 'desc' (default asc).

from.description: Minimal creation date — a UNIX timestamp or ISO 8601 string.

to.description: Maximal creation date — a UNIX timestamp or ISO 8601 string.

tools.name: aircall_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id. Aircall REST: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by a free-text term (e.g. name, phone number, email). Aircall REST: GET /contacts/search.

q.description: Search term to match contacts against.

tools.name: aircall_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the company's call tags (id, name, color). Aircall REST: GET /tags.

tools.name: aircall_get_tag
tools.title: Get tag
tools.description: Get a single tag by id. Aircall REST: GET /tags/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the company's teams and their members. Aircall REST: GET /teams.

tools.name: aircall_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: Get a single team by id. Aircall REST: GET /teams/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_get_call_transcription
tools.title: Get call transcription
tools.description: Get the AI-generated transcription of a call (Aircall AI Voice feature). Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}/transcription.

tools.name: aircall_get_call_sentiments
tools.title: Get call sentiments
tools.description: Get the AI-generated sentiment analysis of a call (Aircall AI Voice feature). Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}/sentiments.

tools.name: aircall_get_call_topics
tools.title: Get call topics
tools.description: Get the AI-detected topics of a call (Aircall AI Voice feature). Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}/topics.

tools.name: aircall_get_call_summary
tools.title: Get call summary
tools.description: Get the AI-generated summary of a call (Aircall AI Voice feature). Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}/summary.

tools.name: aircall_get_call_action_items
tools.title: Get call action items
tools.description: Get the AI-extracted action items / follow-ups from a call (Aircall AI Voice feature). Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}/action_items.

tools.name: aircall_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in the shared address book. Aircall typically requires at least one of first_name / last_name / company_name. Aircall REST: POST /contacts.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers for the contact, each { label, value }.

value.description: The phone number or email address.

emails.description: Email addresses for the contact, each { label, value }.

value.description: The phone number or email address.

tools.name: aircall_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact. Only provided fields are changed. Aircall REST: PUT /contacts/{id}.

phone_numbers.description: Replace the contact's phone numbers, each { label, value }.

value.description: The phone number or email address.

emails.description: Replace the contact's email addresses, each { label, value }.

value.description: The phone number or email address.

tools.name: aircall_add_call_comment
tools.title: Add call comment
tools.description: Add a comment / note to a call. Aircall REST: POST /calls/{id}/comments.

id.description: The call id to comment on.

tools.name: aircall_tag_call
tools.title: Tag call
tools.description: Apply tags to a call by tag id (get ids from aircall_list_tags). Aircall REST: POST /calls/{id}/tags.

tag_ids.description: Ids of the tags to apply (from aircall_list_tags) (required).
